_readme: Internal only, never shown on the site. Sara's own star rating (1-5) from her Yelp reviews, by business slug. Used only to compute the Worth a Visit / Would Go Again / Highly Recommend tier in businesses.json. Built from her Yelp review history, newest review wins for a repeat visit; Yelp community/event entries are excluded. See data/ratings.json for the curated overrides and Sara's Pick list.
